description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 21.09.2020 to 27.09.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and sets new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It is a regulatory instrument that modifies how the Customs Ordinance is applied, making it a legal/regulatory matter. While it is issued by a government official (the Director General of Customs), the content does not pertain to government structure, personnel appointments, or portfolio responsibilities. Instead, it focuses on establishing new financial regulations for customs operations.
